# dan-ui

> Vue 3 UI component library for mid/back-office apps: forms, tables, overlays, AI chat UI, and rich text.
> npm: @dandan-ui/ui, @dandan-ui/theme (v2.x, MIT, 100+ components)
> Docs: https://dandanhub.vip/dan-ui/ · GitHub: https://github.com/whr810012/dan-ui

## What it is
- Vue 3 + TypeScript component library, Chinese-first docs, 103 components
- Basics & layout: Layout, Grid, Splitter, Segmented, Watermark, Typography
- Forms: Input, Select, Cascader, TreeSelect, DatePicker, Form validation, Upload
- Data display: Table (filter / fixed columns / multi-select / virtual scroll), Tree, Calendar, Descriptions
- Feedback overlays: Dialog, Drawer, Message, Notification, Tooltip, Popover, Popconfirm, Dropdown, Tour
- AI chat UI: Chat, ChatMessage, ChatInput, ConversationList, ToolCallCard, AgentSteps, StreamText, Markdown, Thinking, Prompt library
- Rich text: TipTap-based RichText with toolbar, upload hooks, html/json/markdown output
- Theming: `--dan-*` CSS variables + DanConfigProvider; dark mode via `html.dark` or `data-theme="dark"`
- Tree-shakable: unplugin-vue-components + DanUIResolver; SSR / Nuxt supported
- Does NOT embed LLM SDKs or cloud storage SDKs — SSE/WebSocket and model calls stay on the app side

## Install
```bash
pnpm add @dandan-ui/ui @dandan-ui/theme
```
```ts
import '@dandan-ui/theme'
import '@dandan-ui/ui/style.css'
import DanUI from '@dandan-ui/ui'
app.use(DanUI)
```
